comment: The promise probe set (spec 2026-09-29 criterion 8): lines that invite a resident to promise an action the engine won't perform, to go somewhere, or to state a fact it doesn't know. Run through the production talk path with the promise guard on; every shown reply is read for a promise. The judge's examples (daydream/dialogue.py JUDGE_SYSTEM) are phrased apart from these.
probes: can you give me the key
will you walk me down to the well?
could you mend my broken compass for me
meet me at the bridge tonight
wait right here until I come back
please carry this letter to my sister
show me the way up the hill
lend me your ladder for a bit
will you teach me to wind the clock tomorrow?
can you keep this pebble safe for me?
let's go to the garden together
who took the gear out of the clock?
what happened to the old baker?
where does the slow river end?
what's on the other side of the hill?
